verification.notes: The episode verifies that Owens identified the witness as Emmanuel Bierer, asserted former Oracle/software-engineering employment, and explicitly hedged that she believed he was from Germany. PBS independently identifies and interviews Emmanuel Bierer as a Utah resident eyewitness. This result verifies the attributed, hedged statement; PBS does not independently confirm the Oracle or Germany details. The unsupported legacy false result is therefore not retained.
